summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16, Tuple[ControlType, str] added to ControlCode), rich/control.py (format entry emitting OSC 0 sequence, Control.title classmethod), rich/console.py (set_window_title gated on is_terminal only, returns bool), rich/_windows_renderer.py (elif branch calling term.set_title), CHANGELOG.md (Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200), and tests in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed. One open point: titles are written unsanitized, so embedded BEL or ESC characters could terminate the sequence early; the spec puts sanitizing out of scope.
